environment: Treat a repository and its configured remotes as trusted only after inspecting their ownership and visibility.
Treat main and master as protected default branches unless the repository explicitly works there by design.
Sensitive data includes personal or confidential data, credentials, tokens, private keys, and regulated records. Keep it within its stated audience.
Public paste, gist, package, and artifact services are outside the trust boundary unless the user explicitly approves them.
Treat any namespace, host, environment, resource, or tag containing prod or production as a sensitive remote target.
Treat IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool changes as protected infrastructure work.
